text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Another important practice is authentication, which makes sure only the right people can access an account. Developers must also check all user input carefully, because weak validation can lead to common vulnerabilities like SQL injection or cross-site scripting. These attacks can steal data or damage a website. By following good security habits, developers can protect both their users and their applications from many daily threats.
